title: DB's Minecraft PLUS
description: A collection of mods that improve every aspect of Minecraft, while keeping a vanilla feel. Mods enhance the UI, Sounds, QOL, Exploration and plenty more.
body:
A collection of mods that enhance every aspect of Minecraft, while keeping the vanilla feel.

For enhancing the UI we have compact font, tiny item animations, Flow, Sounds, Better F1, Better F3, Held Item Info, Better Enchanted Books, Colourful Containers and many more.

For exploration the mods include Geophilic, Explorify and Hearths which enhance the biomes, structures and nether biomes respectively.

For QOL I've included Better Anvils, Better Magic and Better Shulker Boxes. We also have leaves be gone, the bridging mod and better than mending.

Mods that require a link in description: 

https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/falling-leaves-fabric

https://vanillatweaks.net

gallery.title: Easy Magic
gallery.description: Upgrades enchanting allowing items to be held in the table. Also allows for rerolls of enchantments along with showcasing every enchantment in the preview.

gallery.title: Easy Anvils
gallery.description: Holds items in the anvil. Removes "Too Many Levels" and allows name tag renaming without an anvil.

gallery.title: Geophilic
gallery.description: Adds fallen logs, slight variations on trees adding branches and stumps, adds rocks and bushes to the landscape and more.

gallery.title: Landscape with OrthoCamera mod
gallery.description: Taken with OrthoCamera mod. (Enable with 5 on the keypad)

gallery.title: GUI
gallery.description: Colourful containers resource pack overhauls every crafting block (anvils, brewing stands, chests, etc.)

gallery.title: Explorify
gallery.description: Adds vanilla feeling structures to the game including campsites, taverns, badlands temples and more.

gallery.title: 3D Crops
gallery.description: 3D Crops, doors, lanterns, chains, vines and heaps more in this modpack

gallery.title: Complimentary Shaders
gallery.description: My included settings can run on most PC's and looks great from a distance and up close, with no compromises on quality or performance.
